column2: Python is a high-level programming language known for readability and versatility.
Overfitting occurs when a model learns training data too closely and performs poorly on unseen data.
Overfitting means the model memorizes training data and fails to generalize.
Overfitting is when a model is too simple.
Supervised learning trains a model using labeled examples to predict outputs for new inputs.
It is machine learning with labeled data.
It means learning without any data.
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that updates model parameters in the direction that reduces the loss function.
It is used to minimize loss during model training.
A neural network consists of connected layers of artificial neurons that learn patterns from data.
It is a model inspired by the human brain.
